issuer: the Kansas Department of Revenue, Division of Vehicles
note: Kansas Statutes Annotated on ksrevisor.gov (read 2026-10-30): K.S.A. 8-240(f) charges $18 for a class C licence issued to someone 21 to 64 ($20 under 21, $12 from 65); K.S.A. 8-247 has an original licence of someone 21 to 64 expire on the sixth anniversary of the birth date nearest the application (6 years; under 21 it expires at 21); K.S.A. 8-2,101 issues restricted class C licences, the youngest to those 16 but under 17, so a licence without restriction is kept from 17. The $3 examination fee (8-240) and the photo fee the secretary sets up to $8 (8-243) are not held. The identification card: K.S.A. 8-1324(g) $14 ($10 from 65), K.S.A. 8-1325 valid until the sixth birthday after issue (6 years); it is issued to any resident without a licence, so it has no age.

sources.title: K.S.A. 8-240, Drivers' licenses and instruction permits; fees
sources.said: (1) For a class C driver's license issued to a person at least 21 years of age, but less than 65 years of age, $18;

sources.title: K.S.A. 8-247, Expiration of licenses
sources.said: Licenses issued to persons who are at least 21 years of age, but less than 65 years of age shall expire on the sixth anniversary of the date of birth of the licensee that is nearest the date of application;

sources.title: K.S.A. 8-2,101, Restricted license
sources.said: (c) (1) The division may issue a restricted class C or M driver's license to any person who is under 17 years of age but at least 16 years of age

sources.title: K.S.A. 8-1324, Nondriver's identification card
sources.said: Any resident who does not hold a current valid Kansas driver's license may make application to the division of vehicles and be issued one identification card. ... The division shall require payment of a fee of $14 at the time application for an identification card is made

sources.title: K.S.A. 8-1325, Identification card expiration
sources.said: Renewal of any identification card shall be made for a term of six years
